Character Legacy

The Severance procedure hadn't erased the pain, but Borealfelt, despite its bleakness, had inadvertently offered a different kind of therapy. The structure and the necessity of teamwork had forced Irving to engage, to trust, and to, in his own way, connect. As the transport disappeared into the frozen sky, Irving felt a strange sense of release, not from the world, but within it. He knew the routine would begin again tomorrow, but now there was something else too – a glimmer of human connection and a purpose beyond mere compliance. He turned back to the complex, a slight, almost imperceptible smile playing on his lips.

Impact on the World
